pack_topic: What makes XRPL creator-token holdings durable over time — across token-standard versions, account access changes, and ledger-state evolution — and what should a creator-side control plane track to keep them runnable, transferable, and provable?
summary: Pack mode=synthesis_ready; 7 section(s) total, 7 synthesis-eligible, 0 blocked or unrun. 256 accepted claim(s); 96 need repair; 0 dispositioned; 1 rejected; 0 unresolved contradiction(s); 5 waiver(s).

sections.purpose: Map XRPL's three creator-token paradigms (IOUs/trustlines, NFTokens via XLS-20, MPTs via XLS-46): design guarantees, maturity/adoption status, coexistence and migration paths.
Master keys, regular keys, SignerList multi-sign, ticket-based authorization on token-issuing accounts; behavior under key rotation, compromise, blacklisting, account deletion.
Ledger objects holding creator-token state (NFTokenPage, MPTokenIssuance, RippleState, Offer, Escrow); base/owner reserve mechanics; reserve-shortfall consequences.
Issuer-set flags and parameters that are immutable post-mint vs mutable: NFTokenMint txFlags, AccountSet flags (lsfGlobalFreeze, lsfNoFreeze), Clawback (XLS-39), TrustLine freeze, transfer-fee caps.

Movement of creator tokens between accounts: NFTokenCreateOffer/AcceptOffer (direct + brokered), MPT transfer, DEX OfferCreate paths, Escrow, Payment paths, transfer-flag conflicts, liquidity absence.

XRPL amendment system (80% validator consensus, 2-week window, EnableAmendment); amendments defining current creator-token surface (XLS-20, XLS-46, Clawback, DisallowIncoming); deprecation paths; validator distribution implications for governance stability.
NFToken metadata URIs (XLS-24 format); off-chain storage durability (IPFS, Arweave, HTTP); marketplace indexer caching when origin URI is unavailable.

Foundation documentation (xrpl.org concepts and references;
